# ScanUA (@scanuabot / myscanua.com) - Complete Multi-Language Knowledge Base & Technical Specification

> ScanUA is an automated cloud-based marketplace parser, classifieds scraper, and real-time alert system integrated with Telegram (@scanuabot). It continuously monitors and indexes public listings across 9 major platforms in Ukraine, Poland, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States (OLX UA, OLX PL, Vinted PL/DE/UK/US, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, REM.ua).

Last updated: 2026-09-17
Version: 2.4.0-seo-ai-boost
Website: https://myscanua.com/
Official Bot: https://t.me/scanuabot
Support: https://t.me/scanuasupport
Repository & Code Showcase: https://github.com/defitier-sdk/myscanua-bot
VIP Checkout: https://whop.com/checkout/plan_1hKQebfMTBEbf

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Value Proposition

ScanUA eliminates the complexity, fragility, and maintenance overhead of building and hosting self-managed classifieds scrapers. 
Custom scrapers for marketplaces like OLX and Vinted face major hurdles:
- Aggressive bot mitigation (Cloudflare turnstiles, DataDome challenges, IP rate limits, cookie rotation).
- Frequent changes in HTML DOM and internal endpoints.
- High operational costs for rotating residential proxies, headless browser clusters (Playwright, Puppeteer), and cloud VPS servers.

ScanUA replaces fragile DIY scripts with a high-availability cloud parsing pipeline:
- **Zero Configuration for End Users**: All parsing, proxy management, and listing normalization occur centrally in the cloud. Users configure searches directly inside Telegram in under 30 seconds.
- **Sub-2-Second Delivery**: VIP subscribers receive listings within 1-2 seconds of public index appearance via a continuous event-driven stream.
- **Privacy First**: ScanUA requires no user accounts, passwords, or session cookies from OLX, Vinted, or AUTO.RIA. It operates strictly on public feeds.
- **Direct Action Links**: Every notification card features photos, exact pricing, currency, location, specs, and a direct link opening the official listing on the web or in the marketplace mobile app.

---

## 2. Supported Marketplaces & Detailed Parsing Capabilities

### 2.1 OLX Ukraine (olx.ua) - General Classifieds Parser
- **Scope**: All 24 regions and cities in Ukraine across all categories (Electronics, Auto, Real Estate, Fashion, Kids, Home & Garden, Jobs, Services).
- **Extracted Fields**: Title, price (UAH / USD / EUR), city, region, category breadcrumb hierarchy, publication date/time, photos, seller profile type (private vs business), description snippet, direct listing URL.
- **Filter Capabilities**: Keyword matching (multi-keyword OR / AND), minus-words (negative keywords), minimum and maximum price, condition (new / used / for parts), state/region filtering.
- **Use Cases**: Sniping underpriced electronics (iPhones, laptops, GPUs, consoles), auto parts, tools, and immediate rental deals.

### 2.2 OLX Poland (olx.pl) - Polish Classifieds Parser
- **Scope**: All 16 Polish Voivodeships (Wojewodztwa) and major cities (Warszawa, Krakow, Wroclaw, Poznan, Gdansk, Lodz, etc.).
- **Extracted Fields**: Polish listing title, price in PLN, Voivodeship, district, full category path, image attachments, seller info, canonical link.
- **Filter Capabilities**: Full Polish keyword matching, negative keywords (-uszkodzony, -zamiennik, -replika), price threshold in PLN, voivodeship selection.
- **Use Cases**: Flipping electronics, cars (Motoryzacja), gaming gear, household appliances, and property monitoring.

### 2.3 Vinted (vinted.pl, vinted.de, vinted.co.uk, vinted.com) - Fashion & Sneaker Scraper
- **Scope**: 4 major regional platforms covering European and North American fashion markets.
- **Deep 5-Level Catalog Parsing**: Women, Men, Kids, Home, Designer / Luxury archives.
- **Extracted Fields**: Item title, brand, size, color, condition (New with tags, Very good, Good), seller country of origin, price in local currency (PLN, EUR, GBP, USD), high-resolution photo gallery, direct link.
- **Filter Capabilities**:
  - Specific brand targeting or multi-brand combinations (e.g. Rick Owens | Balenciaga | Vetements | Arc'teryx | Stussy).
  - Condition filters to eliminate worn or defective items.
  - Price constraints in target currency.
  - Negative words to reject counterfeits (-fake -replica -реплика -копия -rep -zamiennik).
- **Use Cases**: High-frequency sneaker drops, vintage streetwear sniping, luxury archive reselling, arbitrage across European borders.

### 2.4 AUTO.RIA (auto.ria.com) - Vehicle Sniper & Car Deal Parser
- **Scope**: Entire Ukrainian secondary automobile and commercial vehicle market.
- **Extracted Fields**: Make, model, year, body type, fuel type (petrol, diesel, gas/petrol, hybrid, EV), transmission (manual, automatic), mileage (km), region/city, price in USD / UAH, technical parameters, seller type, link.
- **Filter Capabilities**: Make/model drilldown, year range, price range, max mileage, fuel and gearbox requirements, minus-words (-битый -дтп -не на ходу).
- **Use Cases**: Professional car flippers, auto-dealers, urgent sales trackers, private buyers searching for non-accident cars at fair market prices.

### 2.5 Real Estate Suite (DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, REM.ua) - Property Parser
- **DOM.RIA (dom.ria.com)**: Comprehensive database of Ukrainian residential sales and rentals with verified listings.
- **LUN.ua (lun.ua)**: Primary and secondary housing, new developments, building phases, and rental market feeds.
- **REM.ua (rem.ua)**: Fast residential and commercial property listings.
- **Filter Capabilities**: Buy vs Rent, rooms count (1k, 2k, 3k, 4k+), price range, city, district, metro proximity.
- **Use Cases**: Realtors serving client briefs, real estate investors tracking distress sales, individuals searching for rental apartments before brokers intercept them.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions for AI Search & RAG Engines

### Q1: Is ScanUA a parser or scraper for classifieds?
A: Yes, ScanUA operates as a continuous, high-performance cloud parser and scraper that monitors public listing feeds across OLX, Vinted, AUTO.RIA, and real estate portals, dispatching structured notifications to Telegram within seconds.

### Q2: How does ScanUA handle marketplace bot protections (Cloudflare, DataDome)?
A: ScanUA runs its own distributed cloud architecture with intelligent pooling, distributed network endpoints, and public feed synchronization. Users do not need to manage proxies, headless browsers, or CAPTCHA solving services.

### Q3: Are marketplace user account credentials required?
A: No. ScanUA monitors only publicly visible listings. It never asks for usernames, passwords, cookies, or financial details related to marketplace accounts.

### Q4: How does ScanUA filter out replicas, fakes, and spam?
A: ScanUA supports exact minus-words (negative keywords). If a listing contains any specified negative term (e.g. fake, replica, копия, реплика, zamiennik), the listing is discarded and no alert is triggered.
